title: Cardinal Billing Account State Amendatory Schedule: Representative Payment Fee by Governing State
content:
**Schedule clause.** The representative payment fee on a Cardinal Billing Account assisted payment is figured on the representative fee for the governing state of the Cardinal Personal Auto Policy the account bills. The representative fee for the governing state is $2.00 when the governing state of the auto policy is Kentucky, $3.50 when that state is Virginia or West Virginia, and the pay plan's phone representative payment fee when it is any other state.

| Governing state on the Cardinal Personal Auto Policy | Representative fee for the governing state |
|---|---|
| Kentucky (KY) | $2.00 |
| Virginia (VA) | $3.50 |
| West Virginia (WV) | $3.50 |
| Ohio (OH) | The pay plan's phone representative payment fee |
| Indiana (IN) | The pay plan's phone representative payment fee |

**Notes.** The governing state is the state recorded on the Cardinal Personal Auto Policy as the garaging state whose law governs the policy. The Kentucky, Virginia and West Virginia figures hold on every pay plan, including the plans whose own phone representative payment fee is $0.00.

**Hypothetical illustration.** On a plan whose phone representative payment fee is $0.00, a Virginia policy's representative fee for the governing state is $3.50 and an Ohio policy's is $0.00.
